issue: Non-lava damage above a wide lava river incorrectly reset a checkpoint
resolution: Use actual hazard rectangle overlap

issue: Every demolition wall could be flown around
resolution: Require one full-height demolition gate per mission

issue: String replacement expanded dollar patterns inside the bundled JavaScript
resolution: Insert scripts using replacement callbacks and parse the final scripts

issue: Renderer initialization called an absent resize method
resolution: Implement resize and validate both rendering backends

issue: Hub end left simulation and input active
resolution: Enter an ended mode and guard terminal Hub actions

issue: Guest results menus persisted after the next assignment began
foundBy: Multiplayer transition review and two-page regression
resolution: Clear terminal menus when playing snapshots arrive

issue: Dedicated multiplayer authority could not press Next
resolution: Authority advances after a three-second intermission

issue: Required AI Hub discovery metadata was absent
resolution: Embed session, player, mode, goal, control and duration metadata

issue: Former guest role froze solo simulation after disconnect
foundBy: Transport lifecycle review and bundled regression
resolution: Clear connection roles and gate simulation on active guest status

issue: Guest aiming and HUD referred to the other operator
resolution: Resolve the local seat before aiming and HUD updates

issue: Stale remote inputs could remain active
resolution: Expire remote inputs and clear departing seats

issue: Title and attract operator blinked indefinitely
resolution: Damage blinking applies only during active player runs

issue: Mouse unprojection missed the gameplay plane
resolution: Intersect a camera ray with world z=0

issue: Native keyboard focus could leave controller focus index stale
resolution: Synchronize focus indices and support Tab navigation

issue: Guests lacked discrete sound and particle events
resolution: Relay numbered events with authoritative snapshots

issue: Copy invitation used the partner code field
resolution: Copy the generated local invite/answer field

issue: Clickable pause action was not routed
resolution: Route pause actions through the game state handler

issue: Square and fire used inconsistent standard gamepad indices
foundBy: Gamepad integration review and emulated-pad test
resolution: Use standard button 2 for dynamite and 7 for trigger fire

issue: Retry credited partial rescues and points twice
foundBy: Campaign accounting review and restart regressions
resolution: Restore the mission-entry score, rescues and statistics on retry

issue: SOS and demolition labels survived removed objects
resolution: Hide labels with their miner or wall

issue: Very short touch taps could expire before a physics step
resolution: Queue the contextual blast press briefly
